messages:
adele_newhire: Hi team  I joined Dec 29 and our company had the year-end blackout Dec 2831. My offer said 15 days PTO pro-rated, but my portal shows only 2 days accrued for the year. Can new-hire proration + blackout cause me to lose PTO I never had a chance to use?

matt_peopleops: Hey @adele_newhire welcome! Short answer: new hires are prorated monthly based on start date. If you started Dec 29 most systems show 0 full months accrued for that calendar year, which is why you see a small balance. Blackout doesn't reduce accruals  it only blocks scheduling.

sara_manager: I discussed this with Finance last week. For hires within the blackout window we sometimes grant a "starter allotment" of 8 hours (1 day) at manager discretion so new hires can take an emergency day before formal accruals. Adele, if you need days for travel or appointments in Jan we can approve an advance.

adele_newhire: thanks. Two Qs: 1) is there a way to request a retroactive pro-rate for Dec since I did work those last days? 2) if approved and I get an advance, does that count toward the 5-day carryover cap next year?

matt_peopleops: 1) retroactive pro-rate is only applied for hires whose payroll record shows eligibility and when payroll agrees; it's uncommon but possible if paperwork was delayed. Submit People Portal -> "New Hire Accrual Review" form (link: https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/new-hire-accrual) and attach start paperwork. 2) Any advanced or restored hours increase your active balance and are subject to normal carryover rules at year-end. For exceptional cases we can document it as a new-hire exception for audit but it still contributes to your ledger.

sara_manager: I'm happy to approve the 1-day starter allotment now. Adele, I'll put a note in the portal and approve the advance so you can use it immediately. If payroll later pro-rates the Dec accrual and it results in extra hours, we'll reconcile that with payroll (ledger correction).

hr-bot: People Portal form "New Hire Accrual Review" posted: https://people.redwoodinference.com/forms/new-hire-accrual (auto message).

adele_newhire: awesome, appreciate it. Approved in portal received?

sara_manager: approved and note added. Matt, please flag payroll to treat this as a manager-advanced day and reconcile if needed during Jan payroll run.

matt_peopleops: got it. I'll route to payroll and confirm here once ledger is updated (aim: next payroll cycle). If payroll can pro-rate Dec we'll post an adjustment; otherwise the advanced day stands and will be deducted if you use it.

adele_newhire: thanks all  really helpful and welcome aboard vibes :)
